scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --names 'API,UI' --prefix-colors 'cyan,magenta' "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run docker:up && sleep 5 && npm run db:reset
scripts.seed:python: cd scripts && pip install -r requirements.txt && python seed_data.py
